sources.excerpt: The Wampler Phenom Distortion is a versatile pedal in the Collective Series, designed to deliver a wide range of tones from smooth, punchy rhythm sounds to soaring lead tones. It features a unique JFET-based clipping circuit inspired by '5150' style tones, offering a dynamic response with independent gain, volume, and a 3-band EQ. The pedal includes 'Classic' and 'Bright' voicing modes for a flexible and musical experience, making it ideal for both beginners and professional guitarists. What Wampler Pedals say about the Phenom Distortion Wampler’s Collective Series pedals are packed with features for players of all levels. Designed for affordability without compromising on the qualities that epitomize Wampler, every Collective Series pedal allows you to easily dial in rich, fat tones ideal for beginners and professionals alike. Welcome to the Collective. The Phenom Distortion is a dynamic distortion pedal which uses JFET based clipping instead of Op-amp and Diode based clipping and is loosely based on the legendary “5150” style tones. The fets are driven much in the same way that tubes can be cranked to overdrive an Amplifier into a distorted sound courtesy of a unique Brian Wampler circuit design. The Phenom offers a range of tones from a deep, punchy rhythm sound to an ultra-responsive lead tone perfect for soaring solos and crisp harmonics. It has a flexible voicing switch that selects either bright or classic modes, independent gain and volume controls, and a powerful 3-band EQ. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists praised the Wampler Phenom Distortion for its versatility and range, achieving everything from overdriven blues tones to high-gain metal sounds. Users highlighted the pedal's ability to stack well with other effects, producing various 'brown' tones. Reviewers also appreciated the audible and usable controls, with the bright switch being particularly noticeable, and the minimal noise even at high gain settings.
